items.sujet:
Hello! My name is Yacine. I am fifteen years old. I am from Algeria and I live in Constantine. I am a first-year secondary school student. My best friend is Amine. He is tall and friendly. Nice to meet you!
I. Reading comprehension (8 pts)
1. True or false? (4×1)
a) Yacine is fifteen years old.
b) Yacine lives in Algiers.
c) Amine is tall and friendly.
d) Yacine is a teacher.
2. Answer in full sentences (2×2)
e) Where is Yacine from?
f) Who is his best friend?
II. Language (8 pts)
1. Fill with am/is/are: I __ a student. · He __ my friend. · We __ from Algeria.
2. Subject pronouns: Yacine → __ · Amine and I → __
3. Greeting: complete « Nice __ meet you. »
III. Writing (4 pts)
Write 5 sentences about « Greetings & Introductions ».
items.corrige:
I. 1) a True · b False (Constantine) · c True · d False (student)
2) e) He is from Algeria. · f) His best friend is Amine.
II. am / is / are · he / we · to
III. Marking: content 2 + language 2. Model: « Hello, I am Sami. I am 15. I am from Blida. I am a student. Nice to meet you! »

items.sujet:
This is my family. My father is a doctor and my mother is a teacher. I have two brothers and one sister. My grandfather is old but strong. We love each other and we help each other at home. I have got a small family and I am happy.
I. Reading comprehension (8 pts)
1. True or false? (4×1)
a) The father is a teacher.
b) The mother is a teacher.
c) He has two brothers.
d) The grandfather is weak.
2. Answer in full sentences (2×2)
e) How many sisters does he have?
f) What has he got?
II. Language (8 pts)
1. Possessive: My father → __ job · I → __ family
2. have got: She __ got a brother. · They __ got a house.
3. Family: the brother of my father is my __ .
III. Writing (4 pts)
Write 5 sentences about « Family & Relatives ».
items.corrige:
I. 1) a False (doctor) · b True · c True · d False (strong)
2) e) He has one sister. · f) He has got a small family.
II. his / my · has / have · uncle
III. Marking: content 2 + language 2. Model: « My father is a doctor and my mother is a teacher. I have two brothers. I love my family. »

items.sujet:
I get up at six o'clock every day. I wash my face, have breakfast and go to school by bus. I always listen to my teachers. In the evening I do my homework and read a little. I never sleep late because I get up early.
I. Reading comprehension (8 pts)
1. True or false? (4×1)
a) He gets up at seven.
b) He goes to school by bus.
c) He never does his homework.
d) He always listens to his teachers.
2. Answer in full sentences (2×2)
e) What time does he get up?
f) How does he go to school?
II. Language (8 pts)
1. Present simple: He __ (get) up at six. · She __ (go) to school.
2. Adverbs: put « always » : I listen to my teachers → __
3. Negative: He __ (not / sleep) late.
III. Writing (4 pts)
Write 5 sentences about « Daily Routines ».
items.corrige:
I. 1) a False (six) · b True · c False · d True
2) e) He gets up at six o'clock. · f) He goes by bus.
II. gets / goes · I always listen · doesn't sleep
III. Marking: content 2 + language 2. Model: « I get up at six. I have breakfast and go to school by bus. I always do my homework. »
